method: Author arithmetic recalculation using separately written Python SI expressions, rounding-aware assertions, and explicit physical-boundary review; not independent engineering certification.

units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設線性模態質量m=50000000kg、剛度k=2000000000N/m，ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s，T=2π/ω=0.9935s。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume linear modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m. ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s and T=2π/ω=0.9935s, for this generalized coordinate only.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設所選質量50000000kg瞬時絕對加速度0.20g，F=ma=98.10MN；此數值不是由地表PGA自動得到的壩體反應。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume selected mass50000000kg has instantaneous absolute acceleration0.20g. F=ma=98.10MN, not a dam response automatically inferred from surface PGA.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設m=50000000kg、k=2000000000N/m、ζ=0.05，c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m；只代表線性黏滯阻尼。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume m=50000000kg,k=2000000000N/m and ζ=0.05. c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m, representing linear viscous damping only.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設線性受迫穩態、頻率比r=1、ζ=0.05，R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10；非地震歷時放大保證。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume linear steady forced response with frequency ratio r=1 and ζ=0.05. R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10, not an earthquake amplification guarantee.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設同一線性振子週期T=1s、擬譜加速度Sa=0.40g，Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m；阻尼定義保持一致。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume the same linear oscillator has T=1s and pseudo-spectral acceleration Sa=0.40g. Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m at consistently defined damping.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設兩模態1與3Hz均ζ=0.05，C=αM+βK得α=0.47124s⁻¹、β=0.0039789s；在2Hz時ζ=0.04375。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume target damping0.05 at1 and3Hz. C=αM+βK gives α=0.47124s⁻¹,β=0.0039789s; at2Hz the damping ratio is0.04375.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設原模態m=50000000kg、附加水質量20000000kg、k=2000000000N/m，T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume modal mass50000000kg,added water mass20000000kg and unchanged stiffness2000000000N/m. T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s for this assumed approximation.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設同時刻沿接縫法向位移u1=12mm、u2=−8mm，相對張開u1−u2=20mm；不是各自峰值的非同步組合。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume simultaneous normal displacements u1=12mm and u2=−8mm. Relative opening is20mm, rather than a combination of nonconcurrent individual maxima.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設最短關注週期0.20s、積分步長0.005s，點數T/Δt=40；不能由此保證輸入頻寬或接觸反應已解析。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume the shortest relevant period0.20s and timestep0.005s. T/Δt=40points per cycle, without guaranteeing input bandwidth or resolved contact response.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設初有效垂直應力100kPa、總應力固定而超額孔壓增60kPa，ru=0.60，剩餘有效應力40kPa；非液化整體判定。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume initial effective vertical stress100kPa and excess pore-pressure rise60kPa at fixed total stress. ru=0.60 and remaining effective stress40kPa, not a global liquefaction verdict.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設原型與模型長度比λL=40，原型水深8m及長80m，模型分別0.20m與2m；所有方向採同一比例。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume prototype-to-model length ratio40. Prototype depth8m and length80m become0.20m and2m, with the same ratio in every direction.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40且佛祿相似，原型速度8m/s，模型Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s；不保證雷諾相似。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and Froude similarity. Prototype velocity8m/s gives Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s, without guaranteeing Reynolds similarity.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40、原型總Q=1000m³/s，模型Qm=Qp/λL^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s；不是單位寬度流量比例。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and prototype total discharge1000m³/s. Model Qm=Qp/λL^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s, distinct from unit-width discharge scaling.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40，原型事件120s，模型時間tm=120/√40=18.974s；只適用所選重力相似過程。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and prototype duration120s. Model tm=120/√40=18.974s, applying only to the selected gravity-similar process.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40、同密度重力壓力原型60kPa，模型壓力1.50kPa；此為表壓重力尺度，不代表絕對氣壓也縮四十倍。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and matched density. Prototype gravity gauge pressure60kPa scales to1.50kPa, without scaling ambient absolute air pressure fortyfold.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40、原型重力主導合力2MN，模型Fm=2000000/40³=31.25N；未處理感測器動態或氣泡衝擊。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and prototype gravity-dominated force2MN. Model Fm=2000000/40³=31.25N, excluding sensor dynamics and air-impact scaling.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設ν=10⁻⁶m²/s，以水深為控制長度，模型V=8/√40m/s、h=0.20m，Re≈252982；原型V=8m/s、h=8m，Re=64000000。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assumeν=10⁻⁶m²/s, using depth as the reference length. Model V=8/√40m/s,h=0.20m gives Re≈252982; prototype V=8m/s,h=8m gives Re=64000000.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設ρ=1000kg/m³、σ=0.072N/m、模型V²=1.6m²/s²、L=0.20m，We=ρV²L/σ=4444.4；原型值是其1600倍。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assumeρ=1000kg/m³,σ=0.072N/m,model V²=1.6m²/s² and L=0.20m. We=4444.4; the corresponding prototype value is1600times larger.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設模型水位標準不確定度0.0005m、λL=40且比例視為精確，原型相應標準不確定度0.020m；未含尺度本身誤差。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume model level standard uncertainty0.0005m and exact length ratio40. Prototype-equivalent uncertainty is0.020m, excluding uncertainty in the scale itself.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設獨立流量結果0.098、0.100、0.102m³/s，平均0.100、樣本標準差0.002m³/s，變異係數2%；非全部工況不確定度。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume independent discharges0.098,0.100,0.102m³/s. Mean0.100 and sample deviation0.002m³/s give2% coefficient of variation, not uncertainty for all operating conditions.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume no external exchange and generation flow100m³/s for1800s. Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設局部上庫面積600000m²恆定，抽入180000m³，Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m；大範圍水位需積分實際庫容曲線。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume locally constant upper area600000m² and inflow180000m³. Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m; broader changes require the actual integrated storage curve.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設上庫600m、下庫200m、發電水頭損失15m，淨水頭H=600−200−15=385m；未代表其他流量的損失。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume upper elevation600m, lower200m and generation loss15m. Net headH=600−200−15=385m, without prescribing losses at other discharges.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設單一工況ρ=1000kg/m³、Q=100m³/s、淨水頭385m、總效率0.90，P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume density1000kg/m³, discharge100m³/s, net head385m and overall generating efficiency0.90. P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW at this stated operating point.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設抽水流量100m³/s、總揚程415m、電至水效率0.88，Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume pumping discharge100m³/s, total lift415m and electricity-to-water efficiency0.88. Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW, excluding any separately modeled auxiliaries.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設相同定水頭且起終庫存相同，抽水效率0.88、發電效率0.90，往返ηrt=0.88×0.90=0.792即79.2%。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume equal constant head and identical initial and final storage. Pumping efficiency0.88 and generating efficiency0.90 give round-tripηrt=0.792, or79.2%.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設已扣保留量的可移水量720000m³、定流量100m³/s，t=720000/100=7200s即2h；不保證定功率兩小時。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume transferable volume720000m³ after reservations and constant discharge100m³/s. Duration7200s equals2h, without guaranteeing constant electrical power throughout.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設流量在300s內由0線性升至100m³/s，V=(0+100)×300/2=15000m³；此為水量積分而非水錘驗算。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume discharge rises linearly from0 to100m³/s in300s. Transferred V=15000m³ by trapezoidal integration, not a water-hammer assessment.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設兩庫合計水面1000000m²、日蒸發0.004m，日損失4000m³；未計降雨與滲漏，不可稱封閉循環零耗水。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume combined surface area1000000m² and daily evaporation0.004m. Loss is4000m³/day, excluding rain and seepage; closed-loop does not mean zero water use.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設上庫可用800000m³，其中預留200000m³，其他條件允許時最多移出600000m³；兩項服務不能重複使用同一預留量。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume upper usable storage800000m³ with200000m³ reserved. At most600000m³ is transferable if other constraints permit, without double-allocating the reservation.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設薄壁圓管表壓p=2MPa、內徑D=2m、均勻壁厚t=0.020m，σh=pD/(2t)=100MPa；未含局部彎曲。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume thin circular pipe gauge pressure2MPa, inner diameter2m and uniform thickness0.020m. Hoopσh=pD/(2t)=100MPa, excluding local bending.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設封閉端且軸向無外部約束，p=2MPa、D=2m、t=0.020m，σa=pD/(4t)=50MPa；固定管段需另建約束模型。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume closed ends and no external axial restraint, withp=2MPa,D=2m,t=0.020m. Axialσa=pD/(4t)=50MPa; restrained segments require another model.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設等徑2m、兩端表壓2MPa、轉角90°且忽略動量及重量，F=2pA sin45°=8.8858MN，方向沿兩壓力向量合成。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume diameter2m, equal gauge pressure2MPa and90° turn, neglecting momentum and weight. F=2pA sin45°=8.8858MN along the pressure-vector resultant.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設均勻升溫30°C、α=12×10⁻⁶/°C、自由長度100m，ΔL=αLΔT=0.036m；未含溫度梯度與約束。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume uniform warming30°C, expansion coefficient12×10⁻⁶/°C and free length100m. ΔL=0.036m, excluding temperature gradients and restraint.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設軸向完全固定、均勻升溫30°C、E=200GPa、α=12×10⁻⁶/°C，壓應力幅值EαΔT=72MPa，限線彈性。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume full axial restraint, uniform warming30°C,E=200GPa andα=12×10⁻⁶/°C. Compressive stress magnitudeEαΔT=72MPa in the linear-elastic idealization.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設水平滿管內徑2m、外徑2.04m、鋼密度7850及水1000kg/m³，w=g[7850π(2.04²−2²)/4+1000π]=40.593kN/m。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume a horizontal full pipe with inner diameter2m, outer2.04m, steel density7850 and water1000kg/m³. Combined distributed weight is40.593kN/m.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設簡支跨距10m、均布荷載40kN/m，Mmax=wL²/8=500kNm，兩端反力各200kN；未評估鞍座局部殼應力。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume a simply supported10m span under uniform40kN/m. Maximum moment500kNm and reactions200kN each exclude local saddle shell stresses.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設接觸法向力400kN、庫侖摩擦係數0.15，摩擦上限μN=60kN；靜止時實際摩擦可小於此值。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume contact normal force400kN and Coulomb coefficient0.15. Limiting frictionμN=60kN; actual static friction may be smaller than this bound.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設中心向下合力2MN作用於全接觸基底4m²，q=N/A=500kPa；不是地基允許承壓值且未計偏心。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume a centered downward resultant2MN on a fully contacting4m² base. Averageq=500kPa is not allowable bearing pressure and excludes eccentricity.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設壓力及直徑不變、均勻厚度20mm降至18mm，環向應力100×20/18=111.11MPa，增加11.11%；未評局部坑蝕。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume unchanged pressure and diameter with uniform thickness falling20 to18mm. Hoop stress rises100×20/18=111.11MPa, an11.11% increase, excluding pitting assessment.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設K=2.2GPa、ρ=1000kg/m³、E=200GPa、D=2m、t=0.02m，管壁修正係數取1，a=√[K/ρ/(1+KD/Et)]=1023.53m/s。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. AssumeK=2.2GPa,ρ=1000kg/m³,E=200GPa,D=2m,t=0.02m and wall-restraint factor1. Wave speeda=√[K/ρ/(1+KD/Et)]=1023.53m/s for this idealization.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設均勻管長L=1000m、波速a=1000m/s，往返時間2L/a=2s；只代表此單一路徑，不是允許關閉時間。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume uniform pipe length1000m and celerity1000m/s. Round-trip2L/a=2s describes only this path, not an allowable closing time.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設ρ=1000kg/m³、a=1000m/s，0.5s內減速1m/s且小於2s往返，Δp=ρaΔV=1MPa，ΔH=101.94m。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assumeρ=1000kg/m³,a=1000m/s and velocity reduction1m/s in0.5s, shorter than2s round-trip. Initial pressure increment1MPa corresponds to101.94m head.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設井面積100m²、瞬時流入20及流出5m³/s，dz/dt=(20−5)/100=0.15m/s；流量差不假定長期固定。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume shaft area100m² with instantaneous inflow20 and outflow5m³/s. Rise ratedz/dt=0.15m/s does not assume that imbalance persists.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設定水位上庫、均勻管L=1000m及Ap=10m²、井As=100m²，無摩擦小振幅且忽略井水慣性，T=2π√(LAs/gAp)=200.607s。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume fixed reservoir level, uniform conduitL=1000m,Ap=10m² and shaftAs=100m². Frictionless small oscillations neglecting shaft inertia haveT=200.607s.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設初始井位等於固定庫位、L=1000m、Ap=10m²、As=100m²、V0=2m/s，瞬停下游且無損，zmax=V0√(LAp/gAs)=6.3855m。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume initial shaft level equals fixed reservoir level,L=1000m,Ap=10m²,As=100m²,V0=2m/s and instantaneous demand stop. Lossless rigid-columnzmax=6.3855m.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設Darcy摩擦係數0.02、管長1000m、直徑2m、速率2m/s，hf=f(L/D)V²/(2g)=2.0387m，僅為此工況準穩態損失。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume Darcy factor0.02,length1000m,diameter2m and speed2m/s. Quasi-steady loss hf=f(L/D)V²/(2g)=2.0387m at this condition.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設孔口Q=10m³/s、Cd=0.65、有效面積2m²，水頭差h=(Q/CdA)²/(2g)=3.0159m；未驗局部空化。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume orifice flow10m³/s, coefficient0.65 and effective area2m². Head differenceh=(Q/CdA)²/(2g)=3.0159m, without evaluating local cavitation.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設大氣壓100kPa、表壓−80kPa、蒸氣壓2.34kPa，絕對壓20kPa，比蒸氣壓高17.66kPa；只代表該點該時刻。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume atmospheric100kPa,gauge−80kPa and vapor pressure2.34kPa. Absolute pressure20kPa exceeds vapor by17.66kPa only at that location and instant.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設a=1000m/s、Δx=100m、Δt=0.10s，Courant數aΔt/Δx=1；只對此均勻網格特徵到點，不是完整精度證明。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assumea=1000m/s,spacing100m and step0.10s. Courant number1 aligns characteristics on this uniform grid but does not prove full accuracy.

limits: All numerical inputs are original synthetic teaching assumptions.
No calculation approves a field operating limit, component capacity or site design.
External sources support published methods and project context, not synthetic values.

physicalBoundaryReview.b256: Generalized mass and absolute acceleration distinguished; harmonic steady state is not earthquake response; pseudo spectrum and Rayleigh frequency dependence explicit; relative motion synchronous; fixed total stress required for pore-pressure increment.
physicalBoundaryReview.b257: Undistorted equal-density Froude scale uses Q ratio L^2.5, force L^3; Reynolds/Weber mismatch explicit; gauge/absolute pressure separated; uncertainty and repeatability not global validation.
physicalBoundaryReview.b258: Paired transfers conserve water; level needs storage curve; generation net head differs from pump lift; equal-head round trip and terminal storage explicit; ramp volume not water hammer; external weather exchange remains possible.
physicalBoundaryReview.b259: Thin-wall remote membrane only; closed-end freely extending axial boundary; equal-pressure elbow omits momentum/weight; thermal free versus restrained separated; full-water weight, static friction bound, centered full contact and uniform loss stated.
physicalBoundaryReview.b260: Specified wall factor for wave speed; single path round trip; rapid single-phase first increment not full envelope; rigid column excludes shaft inertia/friction/compressibility; zero initial level offset; Darcy convention, absolute pressure and grid convergence explicit.
